Madonna - Love Without Words EP / 12" Version

“Love Without Words” is a euphoric dance-pop anthem from Madonna’s 2026 album CONFESSIONS II. Produced by Madonna, Stuart Price, and PARISI, the track fuses pulating house beats, shimmering synths, and hypnotic vocal loops into one of the album’s most immersive club moments.

Tracklist:
01 - Love Without Words (Album Version) (Jul. 3, 2026)
02 - Love Without Words (12'' Version 16-Tracks) (Jul. 3, 2026)
03 - Love Without Words (Instrumental) (Jul. 5, 2026)

Source: Qobuz, Hi-Res, Vinyl Rip
Format: FLAC
Artwork covers: Remade by me



Madonna - Fragile EP / 12" Version

“Fragile” is the twelfth track on the deluxe edition of Madonna’s fifteenth studio album, CONFESSIONS II, echoing Madonna’s spiritual path. Lyrically, the song is a direct tribute to her late brother, Christopher Ciccone. After a highly publicized fallout following his 2008 tell-all memoir, “Life with My Sister Madonna,” the two reconciled before his passing.

Tracklist:
01 - Fragile (Album Version) (Jul. 3, 2026)
02 - Fragile (12'' Version 16-Tracks) (Jul. 3, 2026)
03 - Fragile (Instrumental) (Jul. 5, 2026)

Source: Qobuz, Hi-Res, Vinyl Rip
Format: FLAC
Artwork covers: Remade by me



Madonna & Stromae - My Sins Are My Savior EP / 12" Version

Embracing a controversial past and continuous spiritual & mental grinding with Stromae in French, “My Sins Are My Savior” unapologetically confides in Madonna’s love, herself and the dancefloor.

“My Sins Are My Savior is the closing track off Madonna’s Physical Edition of her fifteenth studio album, “CONFESSIONS II”.
The song takes on a mellifluous and tranquil vibe, blending robotic elements and Stromae’s vocals with the elevated Easy Listening sound.
